name: Mrs. Knott's Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup & Warm Buttermilk Biscuits with Seedless Boysenberry Jelly
brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Mrs. Knott's scratch-made chicken broth with tender egg noodles and shredded chicken paired with hot buttermilk biscuits and **strained seedless Boysenberry Jelly** (not whole-berry jam) is soothing and free of berry seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Bowl of Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup with an order of Warm Buttermilk Biscuits (also sold at the Chicken-To-Go counter next door) and use only the smooth, seedless Boysenberry Jelly.
watchOuts: Use smooth Boysenberry Jelly (strained juice + pectin) rather than whole-berry Boysenberry Preserves (which contain gritty seeds)
